note: Offline snapshot. redassay never phones home during a scan; refresh this file deliberately.

advisories.title: Command injection via template and prototype pollution in lodash
advisories.description: Several lodash releases before 4.17.21 allow prototype pollution through _.zipObjectDeep and command injection through _.template.

advisories.title: Prototype pollution in minimist
advisories.description: minimist before 1.2.6 allows an argument named __proto__ to alter Object.prototype.

advisories.title: CSRF and SSRF in axios
advisories.description: axios before 1.6.0 leaks the XSRF-TOKEN to third-party hosts and follows redirects to internal addresses.

advisories.title: SSRF via redirect in axios
advisories.description: axios before 0.21.2 follows redirects without re-checking the destination.

advisories.title: XSS in jQuery htmlPrefilter
advisories.description: jQuery before 3.5.0 can execute script from HTML passed to DOM manipulation methods.

advisories.title: Open redirect in express response.redirect
advisories.description: express before 4.19.2 mishandles certain location values.

advisories.title: XSS via unsafe serialization
advisories.description: serialize-javascript before 3.1.0 does not escape all payloads.

advisories.title: Header leak on cross-host redirect
advisories.description: node-fetch before 2.6.7 forwards the Authorization header across hosts.

advisories.title: ReDoS in semver range parsing
advisories.description: semver before 7.5.2 is vulnerable to regular expression denial of service.

advisories.title: ReDoS in ws header parsing
advisories.description: ws before 7.4.6 can be stalled by a crafted Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header.

advisories.title: Arbitrary file write in tar
advisories.description: node-tar before 6.1.9 can write outside the extraction directory.

advisories.title: Prototype pollution leading to RCE in handlebars
advisories.description: handlebars before 4.7.7 allows RCE when compiling templates from untrusted input.

advisories.title: ReDoS in marked
advisories.description: marked before 4.0.10 is vulnerable to regular expression denial of service.

advisories.title: Prototype pollution in json5
advisories.description: json5 before 2.2.2 allows __proto__ keys to reach Object.prototype.

advisories.title: Signature verification bypass in jsonwebtoken
advisories.description: jsonwebtoken before 9.0.0 accepts keys of an unexpected type, allowing verification bypass.

advisories.title: Path traversal in moment locale loading
advisories.description: moment before 2.29.4 allows directory traversal when a locale name is user supplied.

advisories.title: Proxy-Authorization header leak
advisories.description: follow-redirects before 1.15.4 forwards credentials across hosts.

advisories.title: Uncontrolled resource consumption in braces
advisories.description: braces before 3.0.3 can be made to allocate unbounded memory.

advisories.title: Prototype pollution in qs
advisories.description: qs before 6.10.3 allows __proto__ via a crafted query string.

advisories.title: Command injection in shell-quote
advisories.description: shell-quote before 1.7.3 fails to quote some payloads, allowing injection.

advisories.title: Multiple issues in Django 3.2
advisories.description: Django before 3.2.25 contains fixes for denial of service and SQL injection in specific query paths.

advisories.title: ReDoS in django.utils.text.Truncator
advisories.description: Django before 4.2.11 is vulnerable to a regular expression denial of service.

advisories.title: Session cookie leak in Flask
advisories.description: Flask before 2.2.5 may send a cached session cookie to the wrong client behind a proxy.

advisories.title: Proxy-Authorization leak on redirect
advisories.description: requests before 2.31.0 forwards the Proxy-Authorization header across redirects.

advisories.title: Certificate verification bypass
advisories.description: requests before 2.32.0 may not honour verify=False on the first request in a session.

advisories.title: Request body leak on redirect
advisories.description: urllib3 before 1.26.18 keeps the request body across a 303 redirect.

advisories.title: Cookie header leak on cross-origin redirect
advisories.description: urllib3 before 2.0.7 forwards the Cookie header to a different host.

advisories.title: Arbitrary code execution in PyYAML full_load
advisories.description: PyYAML before 5.4 allows code execution when loading untrusted YAML with the default loader.

advisories.title: XSS via xmlattr filter
advisories.description: Jinja2 before 3.1.3 does not escape certain attribute names.

advisories.title: Denial of service in multipart parsing
advisories.description: Werkzeug before 2.2.3 can be exhausted by a crafted multipart body.

advisories.title: Debugger PIN bypass on Windows
advisories.description: Werkzeug before 3.0.3 allows the debugger to be reached in some deployments.

advisories.title: NULL dereference in PKCS7 handling
advisories.description: cryptography before 42.0.4 can crash on a crafted certificate.

advisories.title: Heap buffer overflow in libwebp
advisories.description: Pillow bundling libwebp before 10.0.1 is vulnerable to an exploitable heap overflow.

advisories.title: Race condition in private key file permissions
advisories.description: paramiko before 2.10.1 writes private keys before restricting their permissions.

advisories.title: NULL dereference in lxml
advisories.description: lxml before 4.9.1 can crash when parsing crafted input.

advisories.title: HTTP request smuggling in gunicorn
advisories.description: gunicorn before 22.0.0 mishandles Transfer-Encoding headers.

advisories.title: XSS in aiohttp static file handler
advisories.description: aiohttp before 3.9.4 reflects unescaped paths in directory listings.

advisories.title: ReDoS in sqlparse
advisories.description: sqlparse before 0.5.0 can be stalled by deeply nested expressions.

advisories.title: ReDoS in package index parsing
advisories.description: setuptools before 65.5.1 is vulnerable to regular expression denial of service.

advisories.title: Log4Shell remote code execution
advisories.description: log4j-core before 2.17.1 evaluates JNDI lookups in logged messages, allowing remote code execution.

advisories.title: Deserialization RCE in jackson-databind
advisories.description: jackson-databind before 2.13.4.2 permits gadget chains when default typing is enabled.

advisories.title: Spring4Shell
advisories.description: Spring before 5.3.18 allows remote code execution through data binding on JDK 9+.

advisories.title: Arbitrary code execution in SnakeYAML
advisories.description: SnakeYAML before 2.0 constructs arbitrary types from untrusted YAML.

advisories.title: Improper filename handling in gin
advisories.description: gin before 1.9.1 does not escape filenames in Content-Disposition.

advisories.title: Terrapin prefix truncation in SSH
advisories.description: golang.org/x/crypto before 0.17.0 is vulnerable to the Terrapin attack.

advisories.title: HTTP/2 rapid reset denial of service
advisories.description: golang.org/x/net before 0.17.0 allows a client to exhaust server resources.

advisories.title: SQL injection via comments in Active Record
advisories.description: Rails before 6.1.7.3 allows injection through annotate.

advisories.title: Denial of service in nokogiri
advisories.description: nokogiri before 1.13.10 mishandles crafted XML.

advisories.title: Denial of service in Rack multipart parsing
advisories.description: rack before 2.2.6.4 can be exhausted by a crafted multipart request.

advisories.title: Argument injection in Laravel
advisories.description: laravel/framework before 8.75.0 mishandles certain query strings.

advisories.title: Session fixation in Symfony
advisories.description: symfony/http-kernel before 5.4.20 may expose cached private responses.

advisories.title: Credential leak on redirect in Guzzle
advisories.description: guzzle before 7.4.5 forwards the Authorization header across hosts.
